title: ErebusHeads
description: get all and any ones head/skull! simply type /eh <players name>
body:
# ErebusHeads

### WHAT IT IS
A lightweight, high-performance tool to spawn custom player-textured heads. Perfect for builders, server owners, and decoration.

### FEATURES
* /eh - Instantly gives you your own head.
* /eh <name> - Spawns the head of any player or MHF character.
* Zero Lag - Extremely small file size and optimized code.

### USAGE
/eh [playername]

### TOP 20 DECORATION COMMANDS
Copy/Paste these in-game to get instant decorations:

1.  /eh MHF_Computer    (Desktop Monitor)
2.  /eh MHF_Camera      (Security Camera)
3.  /eh MHF_TNT         (Mini TNT Block)
4.  /eh MHF_Chest       (Mini Wooden Chest)
5.  /eh MHF_Cake        (Whole Cake)
6.  /eh MHF_Apple       (Red Apple)
7.  /eh MHF_Melon       (Watermelon)
8.  /eh MHF_Pumpkin     (Small Pumpkin)
9.  /eh MHF_Coconut     (Brown Coconut)
10. /eh Avaris11        (Hamburger)
11. /eh ChoclateMuffin  (Chocolate Muffin)
12. /eh MHF_ArrowUp     (Green Arrow Up)
13. /eh MHF_ArrowDown   (Red Arrow Down)
14. /eh MHF_Exclamation (!)
15. /eh MHF_Question    (?)
16. /eh MHF_Enderman    (Enderman)
17. /eh MHF_Villager    (Villager)
18. /eh MHF_Golem       (Iron Golem)
19. /eh MHF_OakLog      (Small Wood Stump)
20. /eh MHF_Herobrine   (Herobrine)


FOR MORE YOU CAN SEARCH ONLINE BUT U CAN ALSO TRY JUST GUESING 

### INSTALLATION
1. Drop the ErebusHeads.jar into your /plugins folder.
2. Restart or Reload your server.
3. Start decorating!
